components.name: WalletCard
components.doc: A payment card with its account around it. The card leans toward the pointer in 3D under a moving glare and flips on a spring to show its back; the balance, the security code and the transaction amounts mask digit by digit. Touch and reduced motion get a still card that still flips and masks.

components.name: WalletCardPreview
components.doc: Ready preview with sample account data.

members.name: id
members.doc: Stable key.

members.name: merchant
members.doc: Who was paid, or who paid.

members.name: detail
members.doc: Second line: category, date or both.

members.name: amount
members.doc: Signed amount: negative for money out, positive for money in.

members.name: icon
members.doc: Icon in the row's badge.

members.name: holder
members.doc: Name printed on the card.

members.name: issuer
members.doc: Bank or product name printed on the card.

members.name: last4
members.doc: Last four digits of the card number.

members.name: expiry
members.doc: Expiry date as printed, such as "08/29".

members.name: cvv
members.doc: Security code on the back. It follows the balance mask.

members.name: balance
members.doc: Available balance.

members.name: currency
members.doc: ISO 4217 currency code used to format amounts.

members.name: transactions
members.doc: Recent transactions, newest first. Pass an empty list to hide the section.

members.name: masked
members.doc: Whether amounts are hidden (controlled).

members.name: defaultMasked
members.doc: Whether amounts start hidden (uncontrolled).

members.name: onMaskedChange
members.doc: Called when the mask is toggled.

members.name: flipped
members.doc: Whether the back of the card is showing (controlled).

members.name: defaultFlipped
members.doc: Whether the card starts on its back (uncontrolled).

members.name: onFlippedChange
members.doc: Called when the card is flipped.

members.name: className
members.doc: Extra class for the root.
